items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, ACTIVE/good to go for MNF vs Bears; Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.implication: Full go for key PHI weapons.

items.text: Caleb Williams ruled OUT for MNF vs Eagles (hamstring); Tyson Bagent full practice, Q.
items.implication: CHI QB downgrade; impacts Odunze etc.
items.opportunity: Bagent start if active; limited offense.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL (hip) on ETR Sunday injury report; multiple reports indicate not expected to play Week 3 vs DEN.
items.why: Hip/groin; DNP all week; McVay comments and RapSheet note not expected.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams primary WR; more targets/snaps for other Rams pass-catchers.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 3 at IND per ETR list and official reports.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in HOU offense.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz 30% route targets last week with Collins out; high TE usage vs Colts D allowing 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT; Jaylen Warren expected to lead PIT RB group with backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.why: Toe; coach: Warren will lead and stay fresh.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back + checkdown volume from Rodgers.
items.opportunity: Warren snaps/carries/routes spike; vertical pass game struggling so more checkdowns.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN; monitoring Flowers/Mitchell/Moore for early clarity.
items.implication: Start if confirmed; DFS implications large.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); not expected IR/surgery per GM; Mariota starts.
items.why: Dislocated elbow (non-throwing); positive long-term but Week 3 out.
items.implication: WAS offense limited; McLaurin still viable but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: Mariota era target share historically solid for McLaurin but SEA elite vs WR.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Projections live; elite ceiling in sims.
items.opportunity: DET backfield/role + matchup supports high-end outcomes.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads PIT RBs; expect heavy checkdown usage as Rodgers vertical game failing; projecting Q Warren in.
items.why: Coach confirmed lead role; practice squad backups only.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + zillion checkdowns; 15+ touch history strong PPG.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND with Collins out: 28% target share / 30% routes last week; IND 4th-most TE yds allowed.
items.why: Fact: 30% routes targeted w/ Collins out; TE-friendly matchup.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: post-fumble only 31% snaps/5 touches; Henderson 65% snaps/16-5 touches rest of game; JAX stout vs RB.
items.why: Fumble led to Henderson lead remainder; still ranks Stevenson ahead but hates the spot.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Heavy carries vs soft run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches / 38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara; RB37 util.
items.conflict: ETR lists Etienne IN but low opportunity.
